title: Apply for a vehicle registration as the carer or guardian of the registered operator
summary: Learn how to apply for a vehicle registration when acting as the carer or guardian for the registered operator.
intro: To apply to register a vehicle as the carer or guardian on behalf of the registered operator, you'll need to visit a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: Must be the carer or guardian of the registered operator.
Must visit a Service NSW Centre to apply.
what_you_need: The 'Application for Registration' PDF form, completed in the name of the carer or guardian.
Proof of identity for the carer or guardian.
Proof of carer or guardian status (e.g., court order, Power of Attorney, or statutory declaration).
Proof of registration entitlement in the name of the operator or the carer or guardian.
A pensioner concession card in the name of the registered operator.
An Authorised Unregistered Vehicle Inspection Scheme (AUVIS) report (blue slip).
Proof of compulsory third party (CTP) insurance.

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the form in the applicant's name (the carer or guardian).
Visit a service centre and submit the application.

faqs.q: Where do I apply for vehicle registration as a carer or guardian?
faqs.a: You must visit a Service NSW Centre to submit the application.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply for vehicle registration?
faqs.a: You need the 'Application for Registration' form, proof of identity for yourself, proof of your carer or guardian status, proof of registration entitlement, a pensioner concession card, an AUVIS report (blue slip), and proof of CTP insurance.
